content_html:
I’ve always liked the idea of using something like CC to handle the integration / acceptance testing, since those will typically take longer than you would want to run as a developer. Granted, I haven’t done this personally – I’m working on getting my co-workers moved into TDD mode and using more of the automated tools available for .NET, but we aren’t there yet. 🙂

Brandon

The whole point about Cruise Control is you don’t EXPECT to break the build, but it catches it when you do.

And I don’t need Test-Driven Development if I don’t ever write any faulty code. Haha.
